text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Uoooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nine hundred ninety-eight!! Nine hundred 
ninety-nine!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HELL YEAAAAAAAH!!!! PASSIONAAAAAAAAATE!!!! 
FIIIIIIIIIIGHT!!!!

An ultra-passionate training session with 
a completely different vibe than usual. 
How it came to this—was from getting 
worked up with her over a certain topic.

"...During a break in the meeting 
regarding training details, the 
conversation drifted into casual chatter—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! You watched that drama too, 
Trainer!? I watched it with my dad!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then you must know this line too, right?! 
'Bring on any training you've got! I'll 
see it through till I've sweated dry!'
choice_data_list:
'Though sweat may run dry, let not your 
soul run dry... Go!'

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! The banter between the 
master and disciple during training is 
just so hype, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! Trainer! Why don't we try 
going with that vibe too?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll be the protagonist, and you'll be the 
master, Trainer!! We'll tackle this 
intense training while channeling the 
drama!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! That sounds totally awesome!! Let's 
do it! Come on! Pleeeaseッ!!

And so, we put together a heavier routine 
than usual, cheering each other on 
passionately as we trained.

And now, she is intently powering through 
her final ascetic practice... or rather, 
training menu: the 'Endless Shuttle Run 
Hell.'

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
G-Gnuuuuaaaaargh……!!!! Ngggh, t-this is 
brutal……!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right...! I... No, *I* swore I 
would defeat that guy! Down in the depths 
of that deep valley...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOAH!!!! Burn, baby, buuurn!! My 
body! MY VESSEL!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa! Haa! Yes... I did it, sirrr~!!
choice_data_list:
"And with that, your training is 
complete."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...No! It's not over yet...! I don't want 
it to end!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please remember! The protagonist 
in that drama trained right to the 
absolute limit... until they collapsed, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If I don't go that far... no! If I don't 
do even better than that, it doesn't count 
as the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up, Trainer!! Right now, we're 
moving past the drama and starting a story 
that's uniquely our own!"

I don't understand what she means, but 
anyway... she's completely serious! 
Continuing any further might exhaust her, 
but what should I do...?
choice_data_list:
...Do as you please! Follow your heart's 
desire!

The meal scene after training was a staple 
too, right?

The meal scene after training was a staple 
too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.text:
I don't understand what she means, but 
anyway... she's completely serious! 
Continuing any further might exhaust her, 
but what should I do...?
choice_data_list:
...Do as you please! Follow your heart's 
desire!

The meal scene after training was a staple 
too, right?

The meal scene after training was a staple 
too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Loud and clear! Alright then, let's join 
forces and brainstorm a menu so 
overwhelmingly passionate it transcends 
drama itself!

And so... a routine was born: repeating 
dashes, bunny hops, high knees, and 
Cossack dances all the way across the 
neighborhood's longest promenade.

...At Bamboo Memory's strong insistence, a 
condition was added: I, her Trainer, had 
to sit on the tire with my knees tucked to 
my chest while she pulled it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"We're all in the same boat now! As long 
as I hear those fiery words from behind 
me, there's no way I'm ever falling 
down!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, full steam ahead!! Trainer, 
combine with me!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAH!! Guts! Guts and giiiit!!
choice_data_list:
Go, go, Bamboo!! Blazing-hot full 
throttle!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Osu...!! Break past... your limiiiiits!!

Incredible... Radiating a fiery fighting 
spirit, Bamboo Memory completed this 
ordeal before the sun went down!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haa! Haa! Thanks to you cheering me on the 
whole time, Trainer, I was able to push 
through...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is it—the training drama meant for 
just me and you, Trainer~!!

She looks even more energized than before 
taking on this menu... Drawing out power 
beyond her limits, she seems to have grown 
immensely!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAH!! Guts! Guts and giiiit!!
choice_data_list: Hang in there, Bamboo! You can do it!
Hang in there, Bamboo! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngggggh...!! G-Grit it ouuuuttt...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... G-GOAL!! Th-That was 
seriously brutal, but...!!

Bamboo Memory was completely out of 
breath... but either way, she had overcome 
a massive ordeal!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAH!! Guts! Guts and giiiit!!

"...However, even before it began, it 
seemed she was already near her limit—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: K-Kuuuh~! M-My soul is burning out~...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't reach the goal... S-So 
frustrating...!

Though it served as training... it took a 
massive toll on her stamina, and she 
remained completely dizzy all the way back 
to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! That drama was famous 
for all its delicious-looking food scenes 
too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Biting straight into freshly picked piles 
of carrots! Or Master whipping up a 
massive plate of fried rice!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Thinking about it made me hungry! 
Let's go change and get something to 
eat!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the meal~!! Man, remembering 
those feast scenes really made me shovel 
down the food without stopping~!

"A delicious meal after intense exercise. 
Nourished and revitalized, Bamboo Memory 
seemed brimming with both stamina and 
spirit."
